name: Kobe Electric Railway
summary: Kobe Electric Railway Co., Ltd., a transportation enterprise founded in 1926 and based in Kobe, Japan, primarily engages in operating railway lines across the country. Its rail network features the 22.5-kilometer Arima Line, the 12.0-kilometer Mita Line, the 5.5-kilometer Park City Line, the 29.2-kilometer Suzurandai Line, and the 0.4-kilometer Expressway Minatogawa. The company's business activities also extend into real estate, childcare services, and the health and nursing care sectors.
